messages:
Priya K.: Heads-up — vendor asked for retest window next week. We need RBAC snapshot & KMS-signed evidence. Can we lock a 2-hour slot?
Alex M.: +1. Prefer Tue morning. Who owns RBAC snapshots?
Jordan S.: I can run the snapshot. Will need a list of roles to include (prod/staging/kms-access).
Priya K.: Include service accounts for model-serving, kms-proxy, and assessor-role. Also add role mapping doc.
Taylor R.: FYI, if we change RBAC during the window, we must publish a rollback playbook. Link to template: https://go/redwood/playbooks/rbac-rollback
Alex M.: For KMS evidence: we should provide key alias list, CMK creation timestamps, and access logs. @sec_ops_bot can export logs?
sec_ops_bot: I can export CloudKMS audit logs. Run `kms-export --project redwood-prod --since 2026-03-01 --output s3://sec-evidence/pt449/`
Jordan S.: Perfect. I'll run that after I snapshot roles. Will upload to presigned S3 links.
Priya K.: Presigned links must expire in 72h and be labeled with ticket #PT-449. Use prefix `pt-449/assessor/`
Taylor R.: Reminder — rotation of ephemeral keys: we need to show access window and key-wrap operations. Add small README with steps.
Alex M.: Small note on RBAC: do not revoke `assessor-view` until they confirm read-only access. We'll do canary revoke in staging first.
Jordan S.: Timeline: Tue 09:00 role snapshot, 09:30 KMS export, 10:15 upload & evidence bundle, 10:30 assessor access handoff. Is that rough OK?
Priya K.: Sounds good. I'll coordinate with vendor. @Eng-Infra Oncall — can you keep an eye on any deploys during 09-11?
Eng-Infra Oncall: Oncall here, will freeze deploys in that window. :white_check_mark:
Taylor R.: One last ask — record the session (meeting link) and append transcript to evidence. Use internal recorder `record-evidence --ephemeral`
Priya K.: Great. I'll send calendar invite w/ PT-449 in subject and include checklists. Thanks team. :pray:
